paragraphs: Rabbi Menachem, son-in-law of Rabbi Elazar bar Avuna.

He is mentioned at the beginning of Vayikra Rabbah, chapter 35, and in Bamidbar Rabbah 11:3. At the beginning of Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 5, he reports Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi Yosna. The beginning of Pesikta deRav Kahana reads Rabbi Tanchum, son-in-law of Rabbi Elazar bar Avina, reporting Rabbi Shimon bar Yosef. At the beginning of Esther Rabbah, chapter 3, he reports Rabbi Yaakov bar Avina.

notes.text: The supplied witnesses differ in Menachem/Tanchum, Avuna/Avina and Yosna/Yosef, while retaining a son-in-law relationship.

The consulted Pesikta deRav Kahana 1 reads Tanchum, son-in-law of Elazar ben Avina, reporting Shimon ben Yosni. These readings are preserved alongside Hyman’s Menachem/Tanchum, Avuna/Avina and Yosna/Yosef variants.
